remarks: Experience condo living at its best at Hathaway Commons!! This beautifully transformed three-bedroom, three-bath residence offers the perfect blend of modern style and ultimate comfort. Enjoy the convenience of an attached one-car garage that leads into a spacious mudroom equipped with a full-sized washer and dryer. The sophisticated eat-in kitchen alongside welcoming dining and living areas, are all enhanced by a cozy fireplace and walk out to a private bluestone terrace, offering seamless access to green space. The main level features a large bedroom with an adjacent full bath, providing flexibility and ease; two more generously sized bedrooms with ensuite baths round out the second floor. The finished basement adds an extra dimension, serving as an ideal space for recreation and home gym/office.   Located on South Avenue, Hathaway Commons offers all the benefits of in-town living via a secluded oasis with a pool-just a short walk from premium shopping, dining, New Canaan's world class library, the Metro-North train station, and celebrated public schools rated #1 in Connecticut. Experience a vibrant community and a residence that perfectly embodies modern, updated living.
